news.headline: Central Florida Fri Nov 27 afternoon: NWS Melbourne (2:04 PM discussion) — drier, cooler air moves in through Saturday, mostly precipitation-free thru Sunday afternoon; prolonged river flooding continues along the St. Johns River with all east-central Florida points in Major Flood Stage; highs mostly in the 60s Saturday (low 70s Treasure Coast), lows mainly in the 50s; rain chances return Monday (20-40%) and Tuesday (50-70%)

Florida housing Oct 2026 — Florida Realtors (released Nov 16): closed sales of existing single-family homes fell 10.1% year-over-year to 19,049, while the statewide median sale price rose 2.2% to $420,000, the eighth consecutive month of year-over-year gains; condo/townhouse closings fell 5% to 6,862 with median down 3.3% to $290,000

Builder sentiment — NAHB/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index fell 4 points to 25 in November, its lowest since April 2012; 46% of builders cut prices (a post-Covid high) with an average cut of 6%; NAHB chief economist Robert Dietz cited building-material costs pushed higher by tariffs, a shortage of construction workers, mortgage rates above 7% and softer consumer confidence

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper surged Fri Nov 27 — three-month LME copper rose as much as 6.5% to above $12,600 per tonne, its biggest intraday gain since January, on short-covering as U.S. equities rebounded; on track for its first weekly gain since early October after falling below $11,500 earlier in the week, though still about 20% below September's record

HVAC — ACHR News: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in an Ekotrope/HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016

Markets close Fri Nov 27 — Wall Street ended the shortened Black Friday session higher: Dow rose 597.69 points (1.19%) to 50,780.64, S&P 500 gained 115.56 (1.61%) to 7,298.34 and Nasdaq Composite gained 543.70 (2.31%) to 24,129.50, with trading closing at 1 PM ET; ahead, the Fed meets Dec 8-9 with futures pricing a December rate hike as near-certain

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 (Heat now 10-7), and the Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86 on Tue Nov 24 (Magic 7-10); next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27 at 7 PM ET, Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28 at 5 PM ET

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — all three games decided in the final minute: Chicago Bears 39, Detroit Lions 35; Philadelphia Eagles 39, Dallas Cowboys 38; Buffalo Bills 13, Kansas City Chiefs 10 on a 57-yard field goal as time expired; no Florida team played Thanksgiving — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
